# Real-model oracle fixtures

SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

This notice applies only to the four `.safetensors` files in this directory. They contain
deterministic oracle activations, logits, and token IDs generated from Hyperion's converted form
of Google's `google/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized` checkpoint at revision
`b6ed86275a6a5735884e208bfed95b445a684ca2`; they do not contain checkpoint weight tensors.

These fixtures are distributed under the Apache License 2.0 only, not Hyperion's MIT option.
See the root [`PROVENANCE.md`](../../../../PROVENANCE.md) for file hashes, transformations, source
attribution, and links to the pinned model card and license.
